stories.title: PTL Toy Drive Returns!
stories.summary: Mark your calendars! The PTL Toy Drive is back on December 5. Join us in Carnegie, donate a new unwrapped toy, and help spread holiday cheer to local children in need. Plus, meet the partners making it all possible.

stories.title: A First Look Inside Bob's Furniture newest location in Cranberry
stories.summary: Daisy Jade tours the new Bob's Furniture location in Cranberry and learns how the company's "Little Bob" program is helping give back to the community.

stories.title: Quick holiday workouts between the gift wrapping and cookie baking
stories.summary: Holiday schedules can be hectic, but staying active doesn't have to be. Dr. Natalie Gentile from Rebel Wellness shares quick, effective workouts you can fit into even the busiest day.

stories.title: Phone storage full? A Pittsburgh tech expert shows us how to clean it up ahead of the holidays!
stories.summary: Before your phone fills up with holiday photos and videos, tech expert Cami Nwokedi shares simple ways to clear storage and keep your iPhone camera-ready all season long.

stories.title: Getting some early sips at the Glitzmas Holiday Pop-Up Bar
stories.summary: The holidays are pouring into downtown Pittsburgh. Daisy Jade gets a sneak peek at the Glitzmas Holiday Pop-Up Bar before it opens at the Omni William Penn Hotel.

stories.title: PTL Chat: Nov. 18, 2026
stories.summary: Heather and David read your answers to the 'Whatcha Think Wednesday' question: 'Has the idea that pets are welcome everywhere gone too far?"

stories.title: Steelers surprise 2-time cancer surviving high school football head coach with Super Bowl tickets
stories.summary: Canon-McMillan head coach was surprised by the Steelers with 2 Super Bowl tickets while preparing his squad for the WPIAL Championship.

stories.title: Massive water main break buckles road and floods parking lot in Jefferson Hills
stories.summary: A massive water main break in Jefferson Hills collapsed part of the road on Tuesday and left some people without water.

stories.title: Pennsylvania game wardens investigating Wilkinsburg illegal deer hunting
stories.summary: The Pennsylvania Game Commission said a man was seen walking through someone's front yard with a crossbow.

stories.title: Chinese President Xi greets Trump at airport ahead of planned summit with Putin
stories.summary: President Trump arrived Wednesday in China, where the Kremlin said he had an informal meeting with Vladimir Putin.

stories.title: The Steelers haven't won a road game in Philadelphia in 61 years. Could that change this week?
stories.summary: Pittsburgh has lost 11 straight games played in Philadelphia, dating back to 1965.

stories.title: Ireland Contracting Nightly Sports Call: Nov. 17, 2026
stories.summary: KDKA-TV's Bob Pompeani and 93.7 The Fan's Andrew Fillipponi discuss today's sports topics.
